test_title: PYST 64: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends Adam, Beth, Carl, Diana, Eric, and Fiona are sitting around a circular table facing the center. Beth sits to the immediate right of Carl. Adam is second to the right of Beth. Fiona and Adam are neighbours. Diana is not sitting next to Eric or Fiona. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Eric?
solution:
Given: 

 
• Beth sits to the immediate right of Carl.
 
• Adam is second to the right of Beth.
 
• Diana is not sitting next to Eric or Fiona.
 
• Fiona and Adam are neighbours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f53443898054aecaf623848409acd557173de8047ef672c53c365284f1dbd88.png] 

So, **Carl **is sitting to the immediate right of Eric.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
